label: KDouble
description: This extension for Karoo allows to use custom fields with double types (HR,Power,etc). Includes vertical and horizontal layout, smart fields, rolling fields, W prime, FTP and bell option
releaseNotes: Less battery and CPU during rides: fields only redraw when something actually changes, and rolling fields no longer read sensors they never show. Climb fields switch as soon as the climb starts, and unit or zone changes now apply immediately. Upgrading from below 3.4.0 still needs uninstall and reinstall - note your settings first.
